newsitem.title: INDIA: India's IFCI to issue preference shares.
newsitem.headline: India's IFCI to issue preference shares.

text.p: The Industrial Finance Corporation of India Ltd (IFCI) said on Thursday that it had decided to issue preferred shares worth one billion rupees.
"The board has decided on 1.0 billion rupees of preference shares in the domestic market immediately," the company's chairman, K.D. Agrawal, told a news conference.
The preference shares will have a maturity perid of seven years and a yield of about 15-17 percent, company officials said.
